ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: This is a substantive writing task requiring the synthesis of multiple thematic threads into a coherent economic summary. While it has clear factual parameters (UK poverty, May 2023 timeframe, specific topics), it involves meaningful compositional latitude — structuring a narrative, weaving together disparate data points, and conveying tone appropriate for a policy/research report. Avocet's stronger scores across Creative Generation, Summarization, and Support Dialogue (all above Lapwing by more than the variance threshold) make it the better choice here. Lapwing's preference for tightly-specified extraction tasks with clear completion criteria is a less natural fit for this kind of integrative writing, even though preferences are dissociated from capability.
